_comment: Hand-authored XP, level and bone tuning (master plan Phase 6). XP needed to leave level L is round(base * L^exponent), so early levels pass quickly and level 99 takes about 1500 XP. With workout_xp 18 and the Phase 5 session length, reaching level 100 takes roughly 25 hours of running. That total is the client's decision (plan §14); change workout_xp to retune it without touching the curve's shape. Phase 7 upgrades will shorten it.

rewards._comment_bonus: Every Nth completed workout pays a bonus and plays the bone-reward animation.
